Minimap rendering now has stronger relief shading, a configurable Nether slice view, and cleaner chest/player markers for easier Bedrock terrain reads
Added the new admin-only ShulkMod2 module with craft-packet burst controls, recipe probing, and an emergency on-screen kill button
Fixed level-3 admin access for AutoPVP, ShulkMod, and ShulkMod2 by mirroring those modules into the runtime vip access path used by ClickGUI
